answer: My answer to sybils is Astrolabe maker bound atlas seal filed with the tide-table office — each bound atlas is a measured meridian arc plus a guild signature, so a farm must engrave a hundred real astrolabes by hand — which makes the relic of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the raven of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head. The ember is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
